title: Jal Jeevan Mission High-Level Overview
publisher: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: Jal Jeevan Mission is envisioned to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections to rural households.

sections.heading: High-level purpose
sections.content: The Mission uses a community approach to water and includes information, education, and communication as a key component.

sections.heading: Source sustainability
sections.content: The official Mission overview lists recharge, reuse through greywater management, water conservation, and rainwater harvesting as source-sustainability measures.

scope: High-level rural drinking-water overview only; no application, eligibility, benefit, contact, or operational guidance.
verificationNotes: Reviewed against the official Jal Jeevan Mission website on 2026-08-08.
